## Task

Task: #REPLACE_WITH_ISSUE_NUMBER

Keep `Task: #N` on its own line so Project automation can identify the issue.
Use a draft PR while working; mark it ready when the other participant can review it.

Use `Refs #N` for a partial delivery. Use `Closes #N` only when this PR meets
all acceptance criteria of issue N. Importing files alone does not complete
user discussions, supervisor feedback or a review task.
